title: Boeing F-15EX St. Louis production line: F-15EX Production Rebounds, Deliveries Continue
publisher: U.S. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center
summary: The Air Force reported that a St. Louis strike halted the production line from August 4 through November 17, 2025, before deliveries resumed. Phase 56E entity use: The cumulative delivery sequence is retained alongside planned rate, quality, and strike constraints without inferring one production cause.
key_findings: The record identified deliveries of aircraft 14, 15, and 16 around the interruption and restart.
Entity layer: St. Louis F-15EX production and delivery sequence.
Compatibility boundary: Same line and product; milestone counts and the strike interval establish sequence, not a counterfactual.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: The Air Force account establishes sequence and attribution but not the counterfactual schedule, cost, quality, or labor effect.
Air Force operational account and independent GAO program context.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
